answer: Reputation decay with cooling. Identities earn score from completed tasks; score decays unless they submit a periodic work proof. A clone starts at zero and must wait one cooling cycle before bidding, while honest agents keep score without restarting. At bid time, zero-score identities are held until the next summit epoch. An attacker pays fresh proof compute and idle time per clone; at current shale prices that exceeds reusing one honest account. Saffron tokens are unnecessary—cost is compute and delay.
